name: Maintenance Mode
description: Shows visitors a polished coming-soon or maintenance page while you build, with an optional launch countdown and contact line. Signed-in editors still see the real site.

panels.title: Maintenance mode
panels.description: While this is on, visitors see a coming-soon or maintenance page instead of the site. Editors signed in to this Stride still see the real pages, with a small badge. Dutch pages get Dutch default text.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show the maintenance page to visitors
fields.description: Turn this off to open the site to everyone.

fields.name: site-name
fields.title: Site name
fields.description: Shown small above the headline. Leave it empty to show none.

fields.name: headline
fields.title: Headline
fields.description: Leave it empty for the default, which fits the kind of page.

fields.name: message
fields.title: Message
fields.description: Leave it empty for the default. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

fields.name: launch
fields.title: Launch date
fields.description: Such as 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01 09:00, in the visitor's local time. Shows the date and a live countdown. Leave it empty for neither.

fields.name: contact
fields.title: Contact line
fields.description: An e-mail address becomes a link; anything else, such as a phone number, is shown as written. Leave it empty to show none.

fields.name: accent
fields.title: Accent colour
fields.description: Used for the background glow, the status dot and link underlines. Text colours stay readable whatever you pick.

fields.name: badge
fields.title: Remind editors that maintenance mode is on
fields.description: Signed-in editors see a small badge in the corner of every page.
